letter_deductions.deduction: Pre-existing condition waiting period counted from migration
letter_deductions.why: Same-insurer migration endorsement confirms uninterrupted equivalent cover from 01 Jan 2022. Coverage migrated on 01 Jan 2026 with no sum-insured increase. The insurer accepted the disclosed diabetes. On 10 Aug 2026 credited continuity exceeded 36 months.
